title: app-audit source registry
description: Registry of authoritative sources relied on by an audit (requirements section E). Root may be a bare array of entries or an object with an 'entries' array plus freshness metadata.

freshnessWindows.description: Configurable defaults, in days. Stale entries become SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED and must be re-researched before being relied on.

rule_id.description: Stable id referenced from findings, e.g. 'CCPA-THRESHOLDS'.

jurisdiction.description: e.g. US-Federal, US-CA, EU, global, platform:Apple.

authority_type.description: Authority order for compliance research: statutory/regulatory text > regulator/enforcement agency > official government guidance > official platform policy > court decisions > other primary material > secondary analysis (context only).

authority_name.description: e.g. FTC, California Legislature, CPPA, U.S. Copyright Office, Apple Developer, Google Play Developer.

last_verified.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Drives the freshness window check.

freshness_class.description: Selects the freshness window. When absent, freshness_check.py infers it from authority_type.

freshness_window_days.description: Per-entry override of the class default window.

review_required.description: Set true when the entry is known SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED regardless of dates.

verified_by.description: Which agent verified it, e.g. app-audit-source-verifier.

adversarial_checks.description: Which adversarial status checks were performed (amended, vacated, repealed, superseded, injunction, court challenge, new regulation, updated policy).

conflicts.description: Recorded conflicts between regulator guidance and platform guidance, or between sources.
